Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Jun-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. (MAKEUP) EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 1071-PHY/ECE_1071-B/ECE 1051-B - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)                An n-channel MOSFET has                                                                                 (4)  
  Determine the value of VGS required to get 10 mA saturated drain current. Also explain pinch-off  
  state of operation in n-channel enhancement MOSFET.  
1B)                A germanium diode passes 10 mA current when forward biased with 0.4 V at 27°C. Determine the            (3)  
  reverse saturation current. If the temperature rises to 37°C, determine the forward current, static  
  resistance and dynamic resistance.  
1C)                Determine the voltage for which the reverse current in a Ge diode reaches 60% of its reverse            (3)  
  saturation value at room temperature. Given η =1.  
2A)                A half wave rectifier is fed from a transformer having turns ratio 6:1. The primary voltage is 110V at (4)  
  60Hz. It is decided to have ripple factor less than 0.03 and dc load current of 500mA. Find the value  
  of capacitor needed.  
2B)                In a Zener regulator, RS = 120Ω, RL =250Ω and VZ = 5V. Find the minimum and maximum current             (3)  
  flowing through Zener diode when input varies from 9V to 15V.  
2C)                With neat sketches, explain the channel-length modulation effect in MOSFET.                             (3)  
3A)                Design the square wave generator using OPAMP for the following specifications. Frequency of             (4)  
  Explain the operation with neat  
  circuit diagram and relevant waveforms.  
3B)                Define and calculate the CMRR for an OPAMP, when V1 is 0.25 mV and V2 is - 0.25 mV, output              (3)  
  voltage is 4V. For the same op-amp, when V 1 = V2 = 0.5 mV, output voltage is 6 mV.  
3C)                Perform (21.5)10 - (14.75)10 using 2's complement method.                                               (3)  
4A)                Simplify the following logical expression using K-Map and implement using only NAND gates:              (4)  
  
  
4B)                With the help of a truth table and logical expressions, realize full adder using only basic gates.      (3)  
4C)                Draw the logic diagram of a 4-bit SISO shift register and write the truth table to shift the data 11001 (3)  
  entered from LSB to the right. Mention the number of clock cycles required to retrieve the MSB.  
5A)                A 200W, 90kHz carrier is amplitude modulated to a depth of 65% by a modulating signal of 5kHz           (4)  
  frequency. Given R L = 1kΩ. Determine the  
  i) Total power transmitted.  
  ii) Power transmitted in sideband frequencies.  
  iii) Bandwidth of transmitted signal.  
  iv) Plot the frequency spectrum of the resulting AM wave.  
5B)                For the given binary data 10100110, sketch ASK, FSK and PSK Signals.                                    (3)
